referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 kilogram of synthetic natural gas The gas is distributed by pipeline over 250 km from regional storage. The synthetic natural gas from biological methanation is produced by Electrolysis, PEM, with electricity from grid as feedstock. Transmission loss [% output]: 0.08. Distribution loss [% output]: 0.2%. Regional storage loss [% output]: 0. For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
